rule: the same walk with a helper that started a helper (docs/explanation/working-with-the-ai-while-it-works.md)

rule: a run with the agent's task-list tools, reads of files that are not there, commands that did not work (one repeated) and a helper with a long name: no bookkeeping line, one short muted line per failed kind, a clean footer at 56, 80 and 120 columns (revision 5, X39 X40 X42 X43) (docs/explanation/working-with-the-ai-while-it-works.md)

rule: a run stopped at its spend ceiling while a helper works: said once, with what is kept, how to continue and how to raise the limit (revision 5, X41 X42) (docs/explanation/working-with-the-ai-while-it-works.md)

rule: what a person can do from the screen beyond watching, each a probe of the arm's own screen: a command list that lists, many commands, a list of sessions and a way to resume, tabs or switching between sessions, going into a helper, and a different marker for each kind of update (revision 6, X44 to X48) (docs/explanation/working-with-the-ai-while-it-works.md)
